import { mutation, query } from "./_generated/server";
import { v } from "convex/values";
import { hashBrowserCode } from "@disposabl/disposabl-kit/server/browser-session";

// Disposable backend only: force an existing synthetic handoff or return to expire.
export const expire = mutation({
  args: {
    code: v.string(),
    field: v.union(v.literal("handoff"), v.literal("return")),
  },
  returns: v.null(),
  handler: async (ctx, args) => {
    const hash = await hashBrowserCode(args.code);
    const row = await ctx.db
      .query("billingHandoffs")
      .withIndex("by_hash", (q) => q.eq("hash", hash))
      .unique();
    if (!row) throw new Error("Fixture handoff missing.");
    await ctx.db.patch(
      "billingHandoffs",
      row._id,
      args.field === "handoff" ? { expiresAt: 0 } : { returnExpiresAt: 0 },
    );
    return null;
  },
});

// A public fixture marker and environment fence; this file must never reach a real deployment.
export const ready = query({
  args: {},
  returns: v.boolean(),
  handler: async () => {
    const providers = [
      process.env.BOAT_API_KEY,
      process.env.R2_ACCOUNT_ID,
      process.env.R2_BUCKET_NAME,
      process.env.R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID,
      process.env.R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY,
      process.env.AUTUMN_SECRET_KEY,
      process.env.REVENUECAT_WEBHOOK_AUTH,
      process.env.RESEND_API_KEY,
      process.env.AUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET,
      process.env.CONVEX_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET,
      process.env.GITHUB_CONNECTOR,
      process.env.VERCEL_TOKEN,
      process.env.CONNECTIONS_ENCRYPTION_KEY,
      process.env.POSTHOG_PROJECT_TOKEN,
    ];
    return (
      process.env.E2E_TELEMETRY_DISABLED === "1" &&
      providers.every((v) => !v?.trim())
    );
  },
});
